name: Parity Mouthend
description: Settle the breath on a count of four as a hawk folds its wings on a roost.

name: Wise Mouthpiece
description: Fix the eyes on one feather-small point of the mark and let the rest fall away.

name: Magnanimous Reedtube
description: Load the dart with the off hand held close to the chest like a folded wing.

name: Nimble Tube
description: Fold in a step on the exhale and bring the muzzle up in one motion.

name: Fearless Plug
description: Blow a qi-fed dart at a target's flank as it turns to face another.

name: Unyielding Cane
description: Hold the reed before the face and draw a thin field across it to stop a stray strike.

name: Huff Verdict
description: Spring up from a crouch and blow a hardened dart in the instant of the rise.

name: Millstone Exhale
description: Shoot darts trailing fine cord so they pin a foe's cloak to a post or timber.

name: Hissdecree
description: Fall from a height on a held breath and loose a field-driven dart on the way down.

name: Huffedict
description: Spread a school volley of darts over a fighting front in one drawn breath while shifting as a hawk circles.

name: Serene Padhead
description: Pair a short breath for the body with a long one for the reed.

name: Dartneedle Gift
description: Rest the mouthpiece against the hollow of the chin for a firm seal.

name: Tranquil Airbore
description: Hum through the reed to hear the bore's true note.

name: Pulsarburst
description: Split a breath into two beats so a second dart follows the first at once.

name: Puff Voyage
description: Slide down a shallow slope in a low crouch while turning the reed onto a new mark.

name: Squall Mouthend
description: Raise the reed on the rise of the second breath to turn a thrust aside.

name: Canemercy
description: Repay a spent breath with two slow draws taken in quick succession during a lull.

name: Pulsar Tube
description: Time two breaths so the second dart strikes the hole the first one made.

name: Burst Triumph
description: Keep up two-beat volleys to hold a line of foes behind their cover.

name: Prismtube
description: Send a heavy dart on the body's breath and a second on the reed's to meet in one shock.

name: Symphonic Exhale
description: Run the school's paired-breath set of blows with step and dart together and each beat answering the last.

name: Eclipse Padhead
description: Tap two short taps on the reed to signal a hunting partner across a stream.

name: Vigor Airbore
description: Wade through a reed bed with the tube held clear of the water.

name: Bloom Dartfletch
description: Seat the shooter's weight on a mud bank with a flat board under the knees.

name: Squall Mouthpiece
description: Aim to cross a partner's line so two darts meet the target from either side.

name: Twilit Huff
description: Retreat through shallow water so the spray hides the departing shooter.

name: Famed Needlepuff
description: Shoot by sound and shadow through river fog at a target heard but unseen.

name: Splendid Reedtube
description: Shoot from opposite banks with a partner so a foe in the water is caught between.

name: Wily Cane
description: Stake a pair of sharpened reeds beneath the waterline of a ford and wait with the tube for the foe.

name: Choral Hiss
description: Close on a foe from both sides so two hunters' darts land on one beat.

name: Plugdecree
description: Weave the school's paired darts through a foe's guard in a drawn pattern of strikes from both banks.

name: Vigor Dartneedle
description: Stand with both feet on parallel lines and the weight even.

name: Peal Plug
description: Peer down the bore against the light and look for flaw or dust.

name: Paritycane
description: Palm two darts at once in the loading hand.

name: Merciful Tube
description: Settle the breath in the lower chest until the tube does not move at all.

name: Inferno Burst
description: Alternate right and left lines of fire as the foe shifts.

name: Canevow
description: Show the muzzle on one line and blow on the other to draw a late guard.

name: Huffboon
description: Switch from one footing track to the other without losing the aim.

name: Squall Cane
description: Block a blade with the reed along one track and answer on the other.

name: Prism Dartfletch
description: Drive a qi-pointed dart down the bore with force enough to punch through plate.

name: Plugcrown
description: Fork a volley along both tracks to cover two exits at once.

name: Pulsar Puff
description: Align both tracks on one point and drive the dart through every guard.

name: Choral Needlepuff
description: Run the school's full pair of tracks in a single drawn sequence of feints and shots and steps.

name: Vigorcane
description: Seat the breath in the field around the body until the shooter feels it as one.

name: Revelation Plug
description: Count two hawk wingbeats to find the pause in which the shot lies.

name: Revelation Mouthend
description: Probe the edge of the field with a thread of qi to feel foes outside it.

name: Paramount Burst
description: Send two darts through the field on a single breath.

name: Plugvow
description: Spread the field like a wing over the flank against a crossing blow.

name: Pluggrace
description: Dive forward within the field so the foe loses the shooter's line.

name: Vacuum Hiss
description: Send paired darts through the field so they strike a single point with one shock.

name: Magnificent Reedtube
description: Keep two darts in flight on the field to follow a foe's weaving line.

name: Vacuumhuff
description: Burst the full field through the reed so a pair of darts shatters a heavy shield.

name: Famed Dartfletch
description: Rain the school's paired field darts from a height onto a broad stretch of ground in one set.

name: Solar Dartneedle
description: Seat each breath in the core before it rises to the reed.

name: Canebenison
description: Feel the core's pulse in both bores of a twin reed.

name: Parity Mouthpiece
description: Anoint the dart with a drop of core qi as it leaves the fingers.

name: Majestic Needlepuff
description: Surge core qi behind a single blow so the dart flies at great speed.

name: Prism Padhead
description: Weave two darts with core qi so their paths loop around a guard.

name: Bedrock Exhale
description: Step into a veil of core qi that bends the foe's sight away from the shooter.

name: Adamant Airbore
description: Wrap the twin reed in core qi to block a heavy cut.

name: Fearless Hiss
description: Concentrate a core-fed needle dart on one point to break through a layer of armor.

name: Plugedict
description: Maintain a core-fed stream of darts so a whole line must stay down.

name: Heroic Plug
description: Compress the core's strength into two darts that pierce as one lance.

name: Sovereign Puff
description: Fire the school's full core-fed twin-bore set in one drawn release of darts at a single target.

name: Reedtube Gift
description: Take the plateau's thin air in three slow draws before any shot.

name: Serene Mouthpiece
description: Sort darts by weight in the hand and swear the straightest to the first shot.

name: Burstgrace
description: Lean into the wind and set the feet so a gust cannot turn them.

name: Storied Huff
description: Blow a dart on the wind's side so it curves onto the mark.

name: Dunepuff
description: Shift from crouch to crouch behind stones while holding the aim.

name: Pall Cane
description: Whip a cloak in the gust to turn a thrown blade or dart aside.

name: Vacuumplug
description: Wait for the lull and drive a hard dart through a guard before the gust returns.

name: Canetriumph
description: Loose darts into the open sky so they fall upon a foe cut off from cover.

name: Radiance Airbore
description: Pledge the whole breath to the wind and loose a dart that bores through shield and mail.

name: Bedrock Burst
description: Fill the plateau wind with the school's sworn volley of darts in one long outward breath.

name: Parity Dartfletch
description: Wrap the reed in soft hide so no knock sounds against stone.

name: Pealcane
description: Chalk a bearing on a rock and swear the shot to that line.

name: Lightfoot Padhead
description: Roll each footfall from heel to toe so the quiet holds in every step.

name: Exhaleverdict
description: Lock the bearing and loose a hushed dart as the mark crosses the line.

name: Solarcane
description: Reload by touch inside a cloak so no sound reaches a nearby guard.

name: Devout Mouthend
description: Take a thrust on the hide-wrapped reed and turn it with no clatter.

name: Feather Dartneedle
description: Move the whole bearing a hand's breadth along the ridge without a sound.

name: Valiant Tube
description: Place a silent needle dart through the eye slit of a sentry's helm.

name: Statute Puff
description: Keep a quiet barrage on the mouth of a path so a patrol cannot come out.

name: Quenched Hiss
description: Trust the oath of the bearing to place one dart exactly through a guard.

name: Tenetburst
description: Run the school's quiet set of drawn blows and bearing shifts that ends on one sworn dart.

name: Merciful Plug
description: Swear the breath to the gale on a murmured count of five.

name: Bedrock Reedtube
description: Grip loose stones with the toes to hold a stance in strong wind.

name: Revelation Padhead
description: Dip the muzzle toward the windward side to feel the gale's push on the tube.

name: Parity Airbore
description: Bind the cloak tight round the shoulder so it cannot snap into the aim.

name: Squalltube
description: Time the blow to the swell of the gust so the dart rides its crest.

name: Deluge Burst
description: Pivot with the gale at the back and swing the reed through the arc.

name: Vigor Exhale
description: Slip sideways at the peak of a gust so a charge goes past.

name: Statute Dartneedle
description: Draw the field close and lean into the gale to ride out a hail of missiles.

name: Steel Cane
description: Join the gale to the breath so the dart bites through plate.

name: Exhaleedict
description: Hold a sworn rhythm of darts into the gale to pin a force on a ridge.

name: Vacuumtube
description: Drive one dart behind a full gale so it flies like a spear and strikes a shield bearer.

name: Magma Huff
description: Release the school's sworn breath into the gale as a long sweeping set of darts over a wide stretch.

name: Benevolent Dartfletch
description: Pick a far peak or tree as the bearing for a long-reed shot.

name: Tube Largesse
description: Balance the long reed across two fingers to find its true middle.

name: Vigor Puff
description: Walk the line of a ridge with the reed carried flat.

name: Tubebanner
description: Send a heavy dart across a stiff wind with a deep qi-fed breath.

name: Canegift
description: Hold the bearing through a long wait without a flicker of aim.

name: Sacrosanct Mouthpiece
description: Lie flat behind the long reed and thicken the field against a crossing shot.

name: Quenched Needlepuff
description: Skewer a guard at the far end of the reed's reach with one hardened dart.

name: Valiant Exhale
description: Loose a long steady hail of darts down a trail to deny it to a company.

name: Quenched Mouthend
description: Set the bearing and hold the wind then loose a dart that finds a leader across the whole plateau.

name: Splendid Puff
description: Run the school's drawn sequence of far shots on one bearing and correct each for the last gust.

name: Tubebenison
description: Seat an oath in the breath and spread it through the field.

name: Luminous Reedtube
description: Test how the gale bends the edge of the field.

name: Volition Mouthpiece
description: Anoint the dart with a touch of field qi and speak the oath over it.

name: Pulsar Huff
description: Blow a dart that the field steers across the wind to its mark.

name: Vigor Hiss
description: Step through the field's current to shift ground between breaths.

name: Revered Tube
description: Spread the field against the gust to turn a missile or a blade.

name: Volition Dartneedle
description: Reload by the pull of the field so the dart seats itself.

name: Vacuum Dartfletch
description: Drive the field behind the dart to pierce armor and the bearer.

name: Lordly Hiss
description: Hold the field open to pour darts down the wind onto a position.

name: Steelplug
description: Speak the oath and send a single field-driven dart that cannot be turned.

name: Grand Cane
description: Perform the school's whole wind and oath set of darts and steps and wards as one drawn breath.

name: Parity Padhead
description: Draw breath through the core as the gale rises and hold it there.

name: Eclipse Mouthend
description: Read open ground for the lines the wind will take across it.

name: Deluge Plug
description: Root the stance through the core as a tree roots in rock.

name: Parity Tube
description: Warm the reed's bore with a pulse of core qi before the first dart.

name: Squallpuff
description: Blow a dart with a core surge that outruns the gale's gusts.

name: Bedrock Huff
description: Step off a bare edge and land with the core steadying the aim.

name: Peal Mouthend
description: Turn a sudden gust of missiles with the reed and a surge of core qi.

name: Lordly Exhale
description: Loose a flurry of darts through the open sky powered by the core.

name: Steel Needlepuff
description: Concentrate the core into one needle that bores through a single guard.

name: Storied Mouthpiece
description: Maintain a core-fed hail down a slope so no band can climb it.

name: Storied Plug
description: Compress the whole core into one dart that crosses the sky and strikes like a lance.

name: Intrepid Needlepuff
description: Unleash the school's full set of core-fed darts across a broad stretch of open ground in one long release.
